name: Amia Rueme
source: Second Princess from the Celestial Realm. Because of her personality, and curiosity towards ancient magic, she started researching powerful Ancient Spells, which lead to her being specialized in offensive magic, instead of support magic like all the other people from the Celestial Realm.
translation: Second Princess from the Celestial Realm.
